beats.care: In a campus hostel? Save your warden's and campus security numbers. Students say they'll keep pushing for concrete changes.
beats.what: Students alleged male students questioned and followed a female student near the girls' hostel around 10:30 pm Sunday.
beats.why: Students say hostel security is weak. They want stronger CCTV, biometric entry and more guards.

cards.body: The university barred two students from their department and hostel, said it will file a police complaint, and set up a committee to probe. The allegations are still being investigated.
Some went to Chatushrungi police station in the early hours of Monday.
cards.caption: students in the overnight protest

cards.q: Does your campus hostel feel safe?

opts: It will investigate the allegations before final action
cards.q: Why does SPPU's probe committee matter here?
cards.why: The committee checks what happened, while the university also plans a police complaint.

hook: 300 students protested all night. *What changed* at SPPU's hostel?

learn.t: SPPU accepted the girls' hostel chief rector's resignation and removed the assistant chief rector after the protest.

tldr: After about 300 students protested overnight over safety at SPPU's girls' hostel, the university barred two students and changed hostel staff.
